reviews.text: Jen and Alicia are the best of the best! They are talented groomers who truly have a passion for making our four-legged furry members of the family look, feel and smell their best. I know our standard poodle is in the best care when he’s being groomed. The salon is always clean, fresh smelling and welcoming. I will never go to another groomer…ever!

I’ve been bringing my older pup to Jen for 4 years now and my baby girl to Alicia for almost 2 years now!
These gals are the only people I trust to take care of my babies. They are talented and genuinely care for my dogs. Cage free grooming is the only option for us, as my older pup doesn't do well with other dogs and my younger pup has separation anxiety. Thank you Jen and Alicia for taking care of my fur babes!

Hands down, the best grooming in the valley! Jennifer transformed my 9-pound fur musket into a majestic tomohawk fur missile, and my pups absolutely love the spa days at Oasis. I highly recommend it. It's a luxury treatment at an affordable price.

Winnie says thank you!  Alicia has groomed our standard poodle twice now, and we LOVE her!  Winnie was so happy when I picked her up, not the least bit anxious, and she looks gorgeous.  She loves the one on one attention, and I love Alicia’s expertise.  She cut Winnie’s hair perfectly, exactly as I requested. The facilities are spacious and super clean. I’m so happy we found Oasis!

I can't say enough good things about Oasis Pet Grooming. For around two years, they've worked their magic on my crazy golden doodle. Despite her best efforts to get muddy and dirty, she always leaves their salon looking and smelling incredible. It's always a great experience, and I'm so grateful to have found them.
Excellent grooming and friendly service; my dogs loved them.

Alicia was so great with our rescue dog we’ve only had for 3 months! She is a little sensitive to new people and had to be muzzled at the vet, but she loved Alicia right away! She looked so beautiful at the end and Alicia was able to get everything we wanted done and so quickly, too! Our dog was happy when we picked her up, and Alicia said she was asking for pets after the groom, which is so surprising and makes us so happy. We’ll be returning clients for sure!

We have a rescue dog that it's very difficult for her to be groomed because of her past. Well Oasis pet grooming is hands down the best place to take your dog to get your dog groomed! Alicia did an amazing job with my baby Daisy!! My wife and I highly recommend this place!!! And I'm telling you, you can't beat the price!!!!

Jennifer at Oasis Pet Grooming is elite. We missed an appointment due to scheduling and had to take our dogs to another groomer. Our dog came back upset and didn't look nearly as good as when Jennifer is done with them. We will never use another groomer. From the way she interacts with the dogs to the products and cage free grooming that she provides, she is just ELITE!
Amazing groomer! Patient, talented, sweet, and great customer service! Communicative and knowledgeable.
